## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta6

### Cleaner visual editor appearance settings
- Split the overloaded Appearance controls into dedicated **Custom areas** and **Colors** sections.
- Keep custom-area visibility, fill opacity, border width and color together before the general map color controls.
- Order map colors consistently: background, zone fill, zone border, mowed area, off-limit, VF-off, channel, gate area and dock.
- Use shorter labels in the color section so Home Assistant's color swatches no longer cover long floating labels such as `Gate area color` or `Custom area color`.
- Increase the editor grid minimum width so narrow configuration panels collapse cleanly instead of squeezing two controls into overlapping columns.
- Preserve existing selectors, values and card behavior; this is a visual-editor layout cleanup only.

Scheduler, current-cycle trail, mower rendering and the beta4 performance pipeline are unchanged.
